name: Coding Club
description: Weekly DSA sessions, open-source sprints and hackathons for every skill level. From your first 'Hello World' to competitive programming.

name: Robotics Club
description: Build line followers, drones and robotic arms. We run hands-on workshops with Arduino, Raspberry Pi and ROS.

name: Music Society
description: Bands, a cappella, classical and open mics. Jam rooms are open every evening and the Battle of Bands is our flagship show.

name: Entrepreneurship Cell
description: Turn ideas into startups. Pitch nights, founder talks, a campus incubator and seed-funding connections.

name: Photography Club
description: Photo walks, darkroom nights and editing masterclasses. We cover every campus fest and run a yearly exhibition.

name: Drama Club
description: Stage plays, street theatre and improv. Acting, scriptwriting, set design and direction, all welcome.

name: Sports Council
description: Inter-department leagues, fitness bootcamps and the annual sports meet across 14 sports.

name: AI/ML Club
description: Paper reading groups, Kaggle teams and applied ML workshops. Learn to train, tune and ship models.
